typography.instructions: Use font-black or font-bold for large hero headings with tracking-tighter. Use standard tracking for body text. Ensure readability and strong typographic hierarchy.

visual_enhancers.public: Glassmorphism for floating navs (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60). Subtle neon glow (drop-shadow) behind the accent color for a 'lighting' effect. Section transitions using fade-in. Dark mode aesthetic for strong contrast with illuminated vehicle imagery.
visual_enhancers.admin: Flat solid surfaces. Sharp 1px borders (border-slate-200). High contrast tables. No soft shadows; use crisp minimal borders instead to define hierarchy and create a structured utility look.

component_name.public: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for hero, bento grids for features/gallery. Customizable accent color injected into CSS variables. Prominent floating WhatsApp CTA.
component_name.admin: Shadcn UI components. Use table, dialog, select, calendar, toast (sonner). Cardless/dense layout for forms and lists. High contrast inputs for POS cashier usability.

grids.public: Asymmetrical bento grids (Tetris Grid) for 'keunggulan' (features) and 'galeri'. Generous padding (p-12, p-16) for breathing room.
grids.admin: High density grids for POS, job cards, and dashboard metrics. Tight gaps (gap-4). Fully responsive mobile-first approach for the owner's view.

layouts.public: Full-bleed hero, structured sections for services. Optical alignment over geometrical. Use responsive grids for 'paket unggulan' and 'galeri'.
layouts.admin: Sidebar navigation (collapsible on mobile). High-density header with quick actions. Ensure layout gracefully adapts from desktop (cashier) to mobile (owner).

motion.public: Framer motion for scroll-triggered fades, parallax on hero image. Smooth hover interactions on services and packages.
motion.admin: Minimal interactions. Fast transitions on hover states (e.g., bg-slate-100). Focus on functional feedback rather than decorative motion.

accessibility.general: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text. Explicit hover states (hover:text-white). data-testid on all interactive elements. Ensure focus outlines are visible for keyboard navigation.

specific_requirements.public_site: Implement CSS variable var(--primary-accent) to apply the CMS-configured color to buttons, highlights, and icons. Ensure the WhatsApp button is prominently floating. UI in Indonesian language, currency in Rupiah (Rp).
specific_requirements.admin_dashboard: Strictly LIGHT mode, no dark mode switch. Thermal print layout (80mm) must be designed using specialized print CSS (@media print). Include a print preview UI. CSV export capability in reports.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT center align the app container.
Use data-testid on buttons, links, inputs, and key informational elements.
Configure Shadcn UI without the default Vercel look. Override styles to match the guidelines.
Install and use framer-motion, lucide-react, sonner.
Apply 'glassmorphism' (Crystal Variant) for headers where content scrolls underneath. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays.
Prioritize responsive design. POS Kasir and Dashboard must work flawlessly on mobile for the owner.
Implement the dynamic CSS variable for the public site's accent color.
Ensure .js/.jsx file extensions are used for React components, not .tsx.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Align elements optimally: left-align dense content, forms, and paragraphs. Only center-align headings when it improves balance.
Avoid fully transparent backgrounds for interactive elements like dropdowns; ensure readability.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
